findings.failure_path: If this hook times out, exits nonzero, or emits malformed JSON, runHook returns an error and enforce throws. An internal guard failure therefore blocks even an unrelated Bash command such as git status, contradicting the required fail-open behavior.
findings.smallest_fix: Enforce this guard only when runHook returns status ok. Add adapter coverage proving runtime errors allow execution while a valid deny still blocks.

findings.failure_path: pytest --tb short passes because short is treated as a positional test filter, although it is the value of the traceback-format option and the entire suite runs. playwright test --reporter line and node --test --test-reporter spec have the same bypass.
findings.smallest_fix: Consume values belonging to runner options before recognizing positional selectors, and add deny rows for these unselected commands.

findings.failure_path: FULL=0 pytest is allowed: every nonempty FULL value clears the guard, although pytest ignores this variable and runs the whole suite without a valid reason. This also accepts FULL=false despite documenting FULL=1 as the explicit opt-in.
findings.smallest_fix: Handle FULL separately from selection variables and accept only the documented FULL=1 opt-in. Pin FULL=0 and FULL=false as denied cases.

findings.failure_path: sed masks quotes one line at a time. A command such as git commit -m "summary\n npm test\n" leaves the middle line exposed, so the guard denies a commit whose quoted message merely mentions npm test.
findings.smallest_fix: Preserve quote state across newlines when masking text, with allow rows for multiline single- and double-quoted messages.

findings.failure_path: If the upstream grep -Ev fails with status 2 and emits nothing, the downstream grep returns 1. Without checking upstream status, the hook interprets this as no selector and emits a deny. The existing failing-tr row does not cover this internal-failure path.
findings.smallest_fix: Check each pipeline component's status and allow on unexpected failures before emitting a deny. Add a fault-injection row for the upstream grep.

concern_results.conclusion: Found option-value and FULL=0 bypasses, multiline-quote false denials, and two fail-closed paths. Reason values are allow-listed; hook registration, adapter inventory, and Makefile wiring align. The testing guidance retains the existing exceptions.
